Public artist homepages declared by both MusicBrainz and Wikidata supply outgoing platform profile links as corroborating evidence. Bounded public HTTPS retrieval does not execute scripts or send credentials. Application identity and unique-profile checks plus explicit user approval remain required before canonical missing links are saved.
